newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sagem sees 1996 net profit up 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sagem sees 1996 net profit up 15 percent.

text.p: French electronics company SAGEM should post a 15 percent increase in net attributable profit in 1996 and a two-percent rise in sales, president Pierre Faurre said in an interview on Tuesday.
"In 1996, our sales should grow by about two percent, the third quarter having been a little depressed," he said in an interview published on Tuesday in daily Le Figaro.
On the other hand, the group's net attributable profit, "should again be in the order of 15 percent, for the fifth consecutive period," he said.
